description: Live 7-reviewer panel: 1x Tier 1b (fixed anchor, Sonnet first) + 1x Tier 2 + 1x Tier 2b + 2x Tier 3 + 2x Tier 4. In the anthropic-only environment it resolves to 1 Sonnet + 6 Haiku (Haiku stands in for Tier 2, 2b and 3; Tier 4 lists Haiku 5.5 itself), the 1S+6H shape measured in the #346 replicate. In the gateway environment it resolves seven reviewers from the tier file's model lists; the claude-gw-tier2b alias must exist on the gateway before it runs live.
